LongDescription             : Season ticket holders and life-long fans of Leeds United, the Kasier Chiefs play their hits from their previous albums “Employment” and “Yours Truly, Angry Mob” as well as premiering tracks from their new album “Off With Their Heads” to a sell-out capacity crowd of 40,000 die-hard fans. Featuring a cameo appearance by super-producer, Mark Ronson, this is definitely not a concert to miss for any fan of the Yorkshire quintet. Features tracks such as “Never Miss A Beat”, “I Predict A Riot”, “Ruby”, and “Oh My God”.
